phase3_9_config.filter_dimension_decision: PROJECT_EXECUTION.md Task 3.9 lists 4 filter dimensions: CIK, year, form, section. Verified against the live frozen chunk artifact before implementation: form_type is a constant ('10-K') across all 323,971 rows - filtering on it is a no-op, not implemented as a real filter. There is no 'section' column at all - Task 3.2 selected FIXED (non-section-aware) splitting, so no chunk carries section metadata. Only cik (1,370 distinct values) and fiscal_year (5 distinct values, 2016-2020) are real, discriminative pre-filter dimensions given the current frozen artifacts - implemented as a compound cik+fiscal_year predicate. This is the 'where possible' scoping PROJECT_EXECUTION.md's own wording anticipates, not a silently reduced contract.
phase3_9_config.extraction_source: src.router.rules.classify_intent() (Task 3.8, frozen, unmodified) applied to each question's raw TEXT ONLY - never the question record's own hidden cik/fiscal_year ground-truth fields, which would be test leakage. A question filters iff the router resolves EXACTLY ONE distinct cik AND EXACTLY ONE distinct fiscal_year from its text; otherwise the query falls back to unfiltered dense search for that question (recorded explicitly as a fallback, never silently treated as 'filtered').
phase3_9_config.prefilter_mechanism: src.index.lancedb_index.exact_cosine_search_filtered() - a scalar SQL predicate ('cik = <n> AND fiscal_year = <y>', built only from validated Python ints, never from raw text) applied via LanceDB's .where(..., prefilter=True) BEFORE the exact/brute-force cosine search - verified empirically (Stage 2) that LanceDB 0.37.1's .where() already prefilters by default, and prefilter=True is passed explicitly anyway for clarity.
phase3_9_config.selection_rule: Reuses src.eval.phase3_ablation.select_round_winner/is_practical_tie/paired_bootstrap_delta_ci UNMODIFIED (same priority order as Tasks 3.2/3.3: doc_recall@50 > doc_mrr > doc_ndcg@10 > doc_recall@10) - unlike Tasks 3.5/3.6, both arms here search the same embeddings/index and can have a genuinely different Recall@50, so the original Recall@50-keyed practical-tie rule is meaningful again. Tie-break (src.eval.phase3_filter.filtered_tiebreak_key): prefer the simpler unfiltered baseline on a practical tie.
phase3_9_config.metric_definitions: doc_recall@10/@50, doc_mrr, doc_ndcg@10 via the same Task 2.6 granularity-agnostic functions used since Task 3.4 - unmodified.

selection.rationale: filtered is a credible improvement over reference baseline on the frozen priority order with no regression-protection violation.

ablation_row.notes: Task 3.9: CIK+fiscal_year pre-filter (router-extracted), 89/89 filtered. Selection: filtered is a credible improvement over reference baseline on the frozen priority order with no regression-protection violation.

limitations: Evaluated only over the frozen Task 3.1 89-question DEV/evaluable-subset (4.9% of full DEV).
Only cik+fiscal_year are real filter dimensions given the frozen chunk artifact - form_type is constant and section metadata does not exist (Task 3.2 selected fixed, non-section-aware splitting).

cik/fiscal_year are extracted from question text by Task 3.8's router - extraction errors would cause a wrongly-filtered (and likely missed) query; this evaluation measures that real risk honestly rather than using oracle ground-truth values.
chunk_recall@10, chunk_mrr, precision@5, faithfulness, citation_grounding, and generation metrics remain N/A.
